children: Telecom, home appliance and media stocks offer investors a haven amid the AI rout, as a widening selloff spurs more rotations out of tech. The Democratic sweep in the U.S. midterms has introduced fresh uncertainty around AI infrastructure, triggering a correction in global tech stocks. As investors grow more skeptical of the sustainability of the AI trade, sectors completely unrelated to AI have become beneficiaries. China Telecom and China Mobile are up 2.1% and 2.7%, respectively, in Shanghai. Home appliance maker Midea Group is up 1.8% and Gree Electric Appliances is 1.1% higher. In the media and entertainment sector, Mango Excellent Media is up 1.4% and Shanghai Film advances 10%. (sherry.qin@wsj.com)
